meta.title: Furkan Kılıçer — Senior Software Developer
meta.description: Senior Software Developer in Istanbul. At Kartega I ship product UIs with React, Next.js, and TypeScript—marketplaces, corporate sites, and payment surfaces.

hero.name: Furkan Kılıçer
hero.bio: I have focused on web technologies since university. I have been shipping software since 2020, and since January 2021 I have been building, maintaining, and evolving real products at Kartega. I work with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Redux on scalable, responsive interfaces.

about.label: About
about.title: Frontend engineering, with product context.

blocks.heading: Background
blocks.body: I graduated from Nişantaşı University Computer Engineering on a full scholarship (3.49 GPA). From school onward I built a habit of research, problem-solving, and picking up new technologies quickly.

blocks.heading: Current role
blocks.body: I am a Senior Software Developer at Kartega Yazılım ve Danışmanlık A.Ş. I have been with the company since January 2021, and in the senior role since January 2025 — owning interface architecture, delivery, and maintenance with product teams.

blocks.heading: Engineering interests
blocks.body: Clean code, SCSS/SASS structure, complex Redux flows, API integration, error handling, performance, and responsive interfaces. I work in a solution-oriented, disciplined way and keep learning.

expertise: REST API integration and error handling

experience.label: Experience
experience.title: Six years of shipping production interfaces.
experience.summary: Career progression from agency web work to a senior frontend role at Kartega, shipping and evolving production product interfaces.

items.overview: Own frontend architecture, delivery, and maintenance across production product surfaces with Next.js, React, and TypeScript.
responsibilities: Shape the architecture of Next.js + TypeScript product UIs
Own delivery quality across marketplaces, corporate sites, and operations surfaces
Strengthen sustainable code structure and performance practices in the team
contributions: Clarified a shared frontend discipline across multiple product surfaces
Simplified delivery and maintenance on complex interfaces
Strengthened scalable state management with TypeScript and Redux

items.overview: Designed, built, and maintained a wide range of customer and product interfaces from scratch into production.
responsibilities: Build responsive interfaces with React, Redux, Next.js, Ant Design, and SCSS
Run REST API integration, error handling, and site optimization
Deliver end-to-end frontend for corporate, payments, and operations products
contributions: Shipped products including Azerlotereya, Footboss, Destekbilişim / Onlinebuyback, and Lidio LAB
Contributed to SistemBul, Hyundai Intraport, and Kemer Country interfaces
Owned maintenance and performance updates on production products

items.overview: Supported frontend training programs across two cohorts.
responsibilities: Support training sessions in May–July and September–November
Help participants progress on frontend topics
contributions: Provided troubleshooting and feedback in practical sessions
Accelerated learning on core React and web fundamentals

items.overview: Delivered customer-facing web pages and site updates for agency projects.
responsibilities: Build and update interfaces for agency work
Ship customer pages with HTML, JavaScript, and jQuery
contributions: Enabled fast iteration on campaign and corporate pages
Handled maintenance and small feature work on existing sites
